name: Leaf-fermented corn wine
summary: Leaf-fermented corn wine is the drink with thắng cố and the shot a host may pour for a guest.
howToEat: Drink it with thắng cố, mèn mén, and grilled corn cakes, or when a host offers a shot.
With lợn cắp nách it comes as rượu ngô or as rượu táo mèo. Mong women are said to know how to cook corn wine.
where: On the plateau, at the thắng cố table or when a host pours it.
seoTitle: Leaf-fermented corn wine on the Ha Giang plateau
seoDescription: Leaf-fermented corn wine, the drink with thắng cố and lợn cắp nách, and the shot a host may pour on the Hà Giang plateau.
